notes: «قال ابن رافع حدثنا وقال الآخران، أخبرنا» differ only in the verb: one level of three co-transmitters (rule 2)
«وساق الحديث بمثل معنى حديث عقيل عن الزهري» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
Abu Bakr speaks inside the story («فقال لهما أبو بكر إني سمعت رسول الله») and the report is cut off there: whether he is a further link is not settled, so he is not added (rule 6)
«عن عائشة، أنصلى الله عليه وسلم» reads as «أن» fused with «صلى», the Prophet's name missing before the blessing: left as written

fixes.reason: «أنصلى» fuses «أن» with «صلى» and the Prophet's name before the blessing is missing; the proposal is for review, the stored Arabic is not changed

evidence.quote: عن عائشة، أنصلى الله عليه وسلم
